values.title: Writing functions
values.summary: Run server code next to your data, with the same typed client and no servers to manage.
values.body:
## Your first function

functions/welcome-email.ts

```
import { fn } from "tessera"
 
export default fn(async ({ db, input }) => {
  const user = await db.users.find(input.userId)
  await sendEmail(user.email, "Welcome to Acme")
  return { sent: true }
})
```

## Deploying

Terminal

```
npx tessera functions deploy
# ✓ welcome-email  deployed to development
```

## Calling a function

```
await functions.invoke("welcome-email", { userId })
```

Runtime

Functions run on Node.js 20 with a 30 second default timeout and 512 MB of memory.
